fusions.name: Branching Current
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of water into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage, then splits to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back. Its damage rises 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 25%.

fusions.name: Parting Streams
fusions.desc: Looses 2 streams of water, spread apart, each dealing 10 damage and knocking the target back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Doubled Back
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

fusions.name: Eelspark
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a bolt of lightning leaps to the next nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
